content: You can give notice after the sixth month, in writing, two months' worth, expiring on the last day of a rental period (tenancy-agreement.md:33). Before that the break clause is not available, and leaving early leaves you liable for rent to the end of the fixed term or until a replacement tenant starts paying, whichever comes first — the landlord has to make reasonable efforts to find one (tenancy-agreement.md:39).
